New decision "Chose an optional ServerIdentity 9th parameter on registerLifecycleTools with spread-if-present response fields over always-emitting fields with placeholder values" relates to:
- 01KWMS1EGTMHWA4YBWJBJYSM3Q: "Chose a full converge pass (reconcileEmbeddings: orphan delete, NULL-hash backfill, embed missing, re-embed mismatched) over threading changed-ID deltas out of ingest"
- 01KWMS1EKM6J8S8N6AAVENV5H2: "Made the probe synchronous before tool dispatch (not fire-and-forget)"
- 01KWMS1EQ3HQM0Q3SH27A3CF1A: "Model inference never runs inside a transaction and all reconcile writes are single upsert/delete statements"
- 01KZCJP87G6PN4D6KN8YZX44SP: "Chose to keep lifecycle status inside the entry JSON blob over adding a sqlite status column"
- 01KZXVD3AXV4Y7PNM46P99NWS3: "Chose to read legacy scopeless handoff records as scope "project" in both list filters and to default createHandoff's scope to "project""
